### `update_privacy_and_access`

**Update privacy and access of an object or location** · `PATCH /api/v3/workspaces/{workspace_id}/{object_type}/{object_id}/acls` · API v3 · 🟡 write

Update the privacy and access settings of an object or location in the Workspace. Note that sharing an item may incur charges.
